findings.one_line: The isolated thin-site clause is not consumed: the oracle upper bound uses only Base plus the isolated envelope, and the lower witness remains in that larger class, so the same matched rate is proved after dropping A_one.

The pervasive-profile clause is inert in the matched route: the upper proof explicitly works on all Base_kappa, while its pervasive witness supplies the lower bound for that larger class; the exact rate therefore does not require A_perv.
